verdict.rationale: GrowthBook supports separate dev/staging/production environments (docs-3) and self-hosting via Docker Compose (docs-10, docs-35) which lets a user run flags/experiments locally without touching prod data, and the MCP server (docs-13, docs-21) lets AI agents call the GrowthBook API. However there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'sandbox mode' for AI-agent testing or guidance on isolating agent test runs from production within the MCP integration itself. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent sandbox/test-environment workflow, documented isolation guarantees for MCP-driven test calls, and independent confirmation of this use case.
